confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Beijing price levels for July 2026, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable; hotel and hostel anchors are less certain and could vary widely by district and season. Cocktail and wine estimates rely on the local beer-to-drink price relationship because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX observation came from a search-result snippet for the RBA exchange-rates overview page (AUD/USD 0.6955 at 4.00 pm, 15 October 2026); I did not open the page or the F11.1 table directly, and other sites showed different figures that are not RBA data.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Beijing's general price level relative to other large Chinese tier-1 cities such as Shanghai and Guangzhou, and to mid-priced East Asian capitals. Cocktail and wine were anchored to the local beer price, since direct knowledge of bar prices is limited.
